course.title: TV Engineering
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: Suppose there is an institutional network where average request from the institutional (12) browsers to the origin servers are 15 per second and each request size is 100kbit. Now, i) What will be the total response time to satisfy the request? ii) If the access link bandwidth is increased from 1.5 Mbps to 10 Mbps, what will be the response time? iii) If without upgrading the access link, a web cache with hit rate 40% is installed, what will be the response time?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
